in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of all gods
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sarvadev हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sarvadev is a name of Lord Shiva, meaning 'Lord of all gods'. He is considered the supreme god in Hinduism, responsible for the creation, preservation, and destruction of the universe.

vedic_reference.note: Sarvadev is a compound name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘सर्व’ meaning ‘all’ and ‘देव’ meaning ‘god’. It is a name for Lord Vishnu, who is considered the Lord of all Gods. Sarvadev is mentioned in various Vedic texts such as the Rigveda and the Bhagavad Gita.
